==XTB KSW 124: Pawlak vs. Kuberski==

|name=XTB KSW 124: Pawlak vs. Kuberski

'''''XTB KSW 124: Pawlak vs. Kuberski''''' is an upcoming [[mixed martial arts]] event will held by [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki]] on December 19, 2026, at [[Gliwice Arena]] in [[Gliwice]], Poland.
===Background===
The event will mark the promotion's 10th visit to Gliwice and first since [[2025 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 105: Bartosiński vs. Grzebyk|KSW 105]] in April 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stachura |first=Bartłomiej |date=2026-09-06 |title=Długo wyczekiwane starcie Pawła Pawlaka z Piotrem Kuberskim ogłoszone na KSW 124  |url=https://www.lowking.pl/dlugo-wyczekiwane-starcie-pawla-pawlaka-z-piotrem-kuberskim-ogloszone-na-ksw-124/ |access-date=2026-09-15 |website=Lowking.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

A [[KSW Middleweight Championship]] title unification bout between the reigning champion [[Paweł Pawlak]] and current interim champion [[Piotr Kuberski]] is scheduled to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Gregorz |date=2026-09-05 |title=Pawlak vs Kuberski! Wyczekiwana walka mistrzowska na gali XTB KSW 124 w Gliwicach |url=https://inthecage.pl/pawlak-vs-kuberski-wyczekiwana-walka-mistrzowska-na-gali-xtb-ksw-124-w-gliwicach/ |access-date=2026-09-15 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>
